objective: Prove: (1) the lift K4 generates a congruence 3-permutable, hence modular, variety and has no Mal'tsev polymorphism; (2) a restriction lemma: height-1 identities satisfied by the polymorphisms of a shadow hold in the clone of its dominated factor, and identities idempotent modulo a congruence hold on its classes; (3) the shadow K6, whose law composes like cycles, generates a variety that is neither congruence modular nor n-permutable for any n; (4) composing like cycles is incomparable with congruence permutability, n-permutability and modularity; (5) every difference law, shadow, lift and disjoint union that composes like cycles has a polymorphism Mal'tsev modulo the tops; state the conjecture that this is forced.
status: Proved by MALTSEV-CONDITIONS-20261021-001B-P001 (V1 prose proof with exhaustive and randomized checks; Hagemann-Mitschke, Day and Gumm characterizations cited). Composing like cycles is not a classical Mal'tsev condition: the lift K4 is 3-permutable and congruence modular (explicit terms) without a Mal'tsev polymorphism, while the shadow K6 composes like cycles yet is neither congruence modular nor n-permutable for any n, since a restriction lemma sends its linear identities to a fibre clone of conjunctions and constants; Z6 has a Mal'tsev polymorphism and fails. Every difference law that composes like cycles, every lift of one, and every shadow of one in which equality of first components is pp-definable is Mal'tsev modulo its tops. Narrower than planned: the shadow operation needs that hypothesis (it fails for the Z3 law paired with itself), and disjoint unions were dropped. Census A's control text wrongly called x+y+z=0 over Z2xZ2 failing; it has parity's free sets, and the Z2xZ2 law with its line congruences fails instead. Open: Conjecture 6, every law that composes like cycles is Mal'tsev on its tops.
title: Proof: composing like cycles is a condition on tops, not a classical Mal'tsev condition
